luld_bands.source_document: [Cooper] - cite the plan document and its effective date
luld_bands.tier_assignment_rule: Tier 1 = S&P 500, Russell 1000, and selected ETPs. Tier 2 = all other NMS securities.
luld_bands.universe_tier_note: This universe is micro-cap and is Tier 2 by exclusion. CONFIRM per event rather than assuming - an event that entered an index would be Tier 1.

brackets.doubled_rule: lesser of $0.30 or 150%, UPPER BAND ONLY

doubling_windows.applies_to: Tier 1 securities, and Tier 2 securities priced BELOW $3.00
doubling_windows.does_not_apply_to: Tier 2 securities priced at or above $3.00

luld_bands.reference_price_rule: Arithmetic mean price of eligible reported transactions over the prior 5-minute period. The reference price UPDATES ONLY when the new value moves at least 1% from the current one - it is a stateful calculation with hysteresis, not a rolling mean. Implementing it as a plain 5-minute rolling mean will produce wrong bands.
luld_bands.pause_note: Five minutes, extendable by a further five. Maximum ten.
luld_bands.price_bracket_crossing_note: LOAD-BEARING FOR THIS UNIVERSE. Phase 11 A2-6 puts implied price at ~$2.21 (T-3) rising to ~$4.52 (T=0), so the median event CROSSES $3.00 during the event and its band goes 20% -> 10%. Two effects compound: the percentage band halves, and the security simultaneously loses its closing-period doubling. In dollars the band is near-constant ($0.442 -> $0.452, 1.02x) while price roughly doubles - so the RELATIVE move required to trigger a halt approximately halves as the event runs. Evaluate the band at every moment, never once per event. Report the share of events that cross a bracket, and the share of halts that occur after a crossing.
luld_bands.crossing_is_a_prediction_not_a_caveat: If halt risk rises through an event, part of that rise is MECHANICAL - the guardrail tightens in percentage terms exactly as the move accelerates. A P(halt | state) model that does not carry the price bracket as a state variable will attribute a mechanical effect to the tape. T4b must carry it.
_open_verification_questions: Whether the closing-period doubling applies to a Tier 2 security that crossed $3.00 DURING the session, or is set from the previous close.
Whether the band brackets key off the previous close or the live reference price.
Both change the arithmetic on exactly the population this universe lives in. Treat as OPEN until the plan document settles them; escalation row 4 applies to any parameter used before then.

route_1_tape_gaps.gap_threshold_reasoning: Proposed well below any plausible pause length so the DISTRIBUTION is visible before a threshold is applied. T1b reports the distribution first; the threshold is applied after.
route_1_tape_gaps.resumption_note: A gap with no prints afterwards is a session end or a delisting, not a halt. Carried as its own class.

route_2_condition_codes.dictionary_path: [Cooper] - path to a committed dictionary file, or the string 'NONE'
route_2_condition_codes.dictionary_note: Phase 11 A2-11 found `indicators` populated on 88.85% of source rows, 99.77% carrying a single code, and NO dictionary on disk - available and uninterpretable. If this resolves to NONE, route 2 produces a census only and identifies nothing. Inferring a code's meaning from its distribution is escalation row 5.

route_3_band_arithmetic.evaluate_at: every quote update, or every minute bar if quote-level proves out of budget

stage_b.authorisation_note: Set true ONLY by Cooper in writing after the T3 gate.

state_variables._rule: Every state variable must be knowable at decision time and lagged by realistic pipeline latency. CLAUDE.md standing constraint. Escalation row 7.
state_variables.bracket_rule: price_bracket and doubling_window_active are REQUIRED, not optional - see luld_bands.crossing_is_a_prediction_not_a_caveat.

reopen.gap_definition: first print after resumption against last print before the gap

stage_b.ruin_thresholds_proposal_note: Expressed as a fraction of account equity, e.g. [0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10]. The T5d table reports, for each, the position size at which the observed p01 adverse reopen produces that loss. It is arithmetic. The agent proposes NO position size - escalation row 15.

cooper_thresholds.row_10_scope: Events with >= 2 routes agreeing on at least one halt. Below this, a reopen distribution cannot be measured and the phase writes the feasibility finding.
cooper_thresholds.row_11_scope: Share of candidate halts identified by exactly one route. Above this, the routes do not corroborate and identification is not established.

runtime_ceilings.on_breach: hard stop; do not silently reduce the cohort or the grid

reporting.n_rule: Every posted table carries n per row. Every prose claim carries its chart filename.
reporting.description_only: No recommendations, no position size, no causal language.
reporting.units_rule: D19 - bp and cents, never one alone
reporting.distribution_rule: Reopen gap is never reported as a median alone. Full distribution and explicit left tail.
